descriptionChirho: The proper name Tsephanyah/Tsefanyahu (צְפַנְיָה), meaning 'YHWH has hidden/treasured,' borne by several OT figures including the prophet (Zeph 1:1), a priest (Jer 21:1; 29:25; 37:3; 52:24; Zech 6:10,14), and a Kohathite ancestor (1Chr 6:21). All three clusters represent orthographic and suffixal variants of the same name: Spanish uniformly renders 'Sofonías,' Arabic 'صَفَنْيَا/صَفَنْيَاهُو,' Korean '스바니야/스바냐,' Swahili 'Sefania,' and Hindi 'सपन्याह/त्सफ़न्याहू.' The longer form -yahu and shorter -yah are standard Hebrew theophoric alternations, not distinct senses.
